votes.summary: The House voted 204-2 to reject a motion to repeal the Authorization for Use of Military Force Against Iraq Resolution of 2002.
House voted to repeal the Authorization for Use of Military Force Against Iraq Resolution of 2002.
Passed the Iron Dome Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2022, appropriating $1 billion to Israel for procurement of the Iron Dome missile defense system.
The bill bans the importation of Russian energy products, imposing trade sanctions on Russia.
Passed a bill suspending normal trade relations with Russia and Belarus and authorizing the President to impose increased tariffs and permanent human rights sanctions.
The House voted to suspend normal trade relations with Russia and Belarus and authorize additional visa and property-blocking sanctions in response to the war in Ukraine.

Passed the Asset Seizure for Ukraine Reconstruction Act, which establishes a working group to determine legal mechanisms for seizing assets of Russian officials and recommends additional energy-related sanctions on Russia.

Passed the Stop Iranian Drones Act, which expands sanctions to cover the provision of unmanned combat aerial vehicles to Iran and requires the designation of Iranian entities that attack U.S. citizens with drones as foreign terrorist organizations.

Passed the Additional Ukraine Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2022, providing $40.1 billion in emergency aid including defense equipment, economic assistance, and refugee support to Ukraine in response to Russia's invasion.
Passed the Russia and Belarus Financial Sanctions Act of 2022, requiring U.S. financial institutions to ensure their foreign subsidiaries comply with U.S. sanctions on Russia and Belarus.

Passed the Isolate Russian Government Officials Act of 2022, requiring U.S. agencies to exclude Russian government officials from international financial meetings and forums until Russia ceases destabilizing activities in Ukraine.
